messages.author: Kriti Shukla
messages.body:
Hey community,
I am trying to install amber18 but in the step
./configure -noX11 gnu
Checking for updates...
Checking for available patches online. This may take a few seconds...
NoInternetAccess: Cannot connect to http://ambermd.org
Check for updates failed.
Error: Unknown or misplaced compiler: gnu
Usage: ./configure [flags] compiler
Type './configure -help' for more details.
Configure failed due to the errors above!
thanks
Kriti Shukla
Research Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur
India. 721302

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
The message says that there is no internet access, you may want to check
that.
Also, consider upgrading to the most recent amber, free for non profits.
